clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Madame Eva offers travelers a ward against Duskwood's dangers. She needs ghoul fangs, skeleton fingers, and spider venom to enchant the Totem of Infliction, a charm that strikes back at attackers.

Madame Eva reads the fortunes of those who enter her candle-lit home in Darkshire. She senses danger and violence ahead, then offers practical sorcery alongside her divinations. To make a ward against Duskwood's predators, she needs ten ghoul fangs, ten skeleton fingers, and five vials of spider venom gathered from the haunted woods.

Madame Eva binds ghoul fangs, fingers from restless skeletons, and spider venom with enchantments. In mortal peril, the totem gives off a magical aura that reflects cruelty, harming anyone who strikes its bearer.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, friend. The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.

If you wish to protect yourself, noble adventurer, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom. For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.

clips.title: Progress

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very wise of you, friend. This Totem of Infliction will help to protect you against the evil which lurks throughout Azeroth and beyond. When you feel threatened, hold this totem and take comfort in its magical aura. Be brave, fair adventurer. You will need all the courage you can muster for I see much bloodshed in your future.
